replacements.article_title: Discipline vs Punishment: What's the Difference?
replacements.search_query: discipline vs punishment choice accountability teaching
replacements.selection_criteria: Clean editorial photo showing teaching, mentorship, or accountability rather than punishment. Avoid prison, crime, or harsh imagery. Prefer balanced light, professional composition.

replacements.search_query: 7 day challenge identity transformation new habit
replacements.selection_criteria: Visual representing transformation, challenge, or new identity. Avoid generic selfie or stock smiling portrait. Prefer concept of becoming, mirror, or first-day action.

replacements.article_title: What to Do When You Miss a Day (Without Quitting Everything)
replacements.search_query: missed day restart get back up resilience protocol
replacements.selection_criteria: Image representing restart, recovery, or getting back on track. Avoid failure, despair, or giving-up imagery. Prefer upward motion, restart button, or return to path.

replacements.search_query: morning routine sunrise early wake up habit
replacements.selection_criteria: Authentic morning scene, not generic success imagery. Prefer sunrise, morning light, simple routine action like writing, stretching, or coffee. Avoid staged 'success' portraits.

replacements.article_title: Morning vs Night: Which Discipline Actually Sticks?
replacements.search_query: morning vs night discipline comparison contrast
replacements.selection_criteria: Image that can represent both times of day or the contrast. Prefer split light, window views, or workspace at different hours. Avoid generic time-lapse landscapes.

replacements.article_title: The Two-Minute Rule: A Complete Guide
replacements.search_query: two minute rule start small quick action habit
replacements.selection_criteria: Visual representing small first step, quick action, or starting. Avoid generic self-improvement quotes or generic 'start' imagery. Prefer concrete small action.

replacements.article_title: I Tried Slow Productivity for 30 Days
replacements.search_query: slow productivity calm focused work no rush
replacements.selection_criteria: Calm, paced productivity scene. Prefer quiet workspace, single task, unhurried workflow. Avoid gym, weightlifting, or high-intensity imagery.

replacements.article_title: The Art of Saying No: How to Set Boundaries Without Guilt
replacements.search_query: saying no boundaries respect distance calm
replacements.selection_criteria: Conceptual boundary image. Prefer doorway, line, pause gesture, respectful distance, or calm assertiveness. Avoid generic smiling portraits.

replacements.article_title: Digital Detox: How Screen Time Is Destroying Your Health
replacements.search_query: digital detox screen free offline quiet space
replacements.selection_criteria: Tech-detox or offline scene. Prefer analog objects, clean silence, natural light without screens. Avoid generic smiling portraits or unrelated calm imagery.
